{{Quote|Sweeper droids? We didn't schedule a cleaning.|This engineer about the "sweeper droids"|<ref name="Heroes on Both Sides">{{TCW|Heroes on Both Sides}}</ref>}}
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] worked on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] as a '''power generator engineer'''. He was [[Death/Legends|killed]] in an [[Bombing of Coruscant's central power distribution grid/Legends|attack]] on the [[Central power distribution grid/Legends|Coruscant power generator]].

==Biography==
Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], there was a debate raged in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] on whether to deregulate the banks to finance the creation of more [[Clone trooper/Legends|clones]] or not. In a bid to sway the votes in their favor, [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]], [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] tasked his [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]], [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]], to transfer his [[Infiltrator/Demolition droid|demolition droids]] to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to [[Bombing of Coruscant's central power distribution grid/Legends|blow up]] the [[Central power distribution grid/Legends|power generator]] and scare the [[Senator/Legends|senators]] into voting for deregulation. When the droids attacked the compound, the engineer was in conversation with a fellow colleague, and was surprised to see the sweeper droids appear as the [[Coruscant power generator engineer/Legends|engineers]] did not schedule a cleaning for that day. He and the rest of the engineers were [[Death/Legends|killed]] when the droids secured the power generator.
